title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Vercel Labs agent-desktop: open-source CLI for desktop control via OS accessibility trees
bullets.summary: Vercel Labs published agent-desktop, a CLI that lets agents drive desktop apps through OS accessibility trees instead of screenshots (GitHub Trending, Nov 6; secondhand via AIToolly, repo not independently reviewed).
bullets.how: The Construct: accessibility-tree control is more deterministic than screenshot clicking; worth evaluating against our computer-use/Hermes flows on the AP-Agent Mac. PRAGMA: reliable-desktop-automation pattern for client ops. Brand 9 Signs: maybe for supplier-portal order entry.

bullets.title: Palo Alto Networks reportedly in talks to buy Clutch Security (~$500M) for AI-agent identity security
bullets.summary: TechCrunch (Nov 5, relayed by AIdapted) reports Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire Clutch Security, which secures non-human identities and credentials used by AI agents; not finalized or confirmed by either company.
bullets.how: The Construct: signal that agent credential governance is becoming a product category; audit how our agents hold API keys/logins. PRAGMA: strong consulting angle (agent identity and secrets hygiene). Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base open-weight MoE model
bullets.summary: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base (Nov 5): 280B total / 14B active parameters, 1M-token context, base-stage weights before post-training (per AIdapted; specs not verified against the primary page).
bullets.how: The Construct: low active-parameter open model is a candidate for cheap local workers, but base weights need post-training and evals first. PRAGMA: open-weight option for cost-sensitive clients. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Anthropic study of 207,049 research sessions with Claude and Claude Code
bullets.summary: Anthropic published research (Nov 5) analyzing how researchers use Claude and Claude Code, finding data analysis and writing dominate (per AIdapted; primary page not fetched).
bullets.how: Informational only: useful framing for PRAGMA's pitch that AI-operator value concentrates in analysis and writing workflows; no action for The Construct or Brand 9 Signs.

praxis_lesson: As agents get real desktop and credential access (accessibility-tree control, Clutch-style identity security), the durable edge is governance: scoped credentials, deterministic control surfaces, and an audit trail per agent action, not raw model capability. (Caveat: items are secondhand from AIdapted/AIToolly Nov 5-7 roundups; no verified new Anthropic release, MCP, signage/CRM/DAM or agent-platform funding news found, so those are omitted. This refreshes the earlier same-day run.)
